definitions.ask: When bob knows an image's original path, which form should `y` copy?
definitions.why: A copied path should work wherever it is pasted

choices.label: /Users/bryan/tmp/screenshots/x.png. Works in any app, file dialog, or quoted shell argument
~/tmp/screenshots/x.png. Matches what you typed, but only shells and Finder expand ~
